ciphersplat.name: CipherSplat
ciphersplat.description: Encrypt and unlock files, folders, and text on this device.
help: Use password encryption for .csplat packages or OpenPGP for public-key encryption. Keep a recoverable original until you have tested decryption.
Folder restoration creates a new folder. Passwords and private keys are not stored. Website links open in your browser.

gifsplat.name: GIFsplat
gifsplat.description: Turn local images into animated GIFs, reorder frames, adjust timing, and save locally.
help: Import image files as frames, arrange them, choose timing and quality, generate the animation, then save it.
Each imported file supplies one frame. This edition focuses on GIF creation. Very large image sets remain limited by device memory.

qrsplat.name: QRSplat
qrsplat.description: Generate standard QR codes for text, websites, email, phone, and Wi-Fi without a network service.
help: Download PNG or SVG and test the code with a real scanner before printing. A QR code exposes its encoded content to anyone who scans it.
Editable redirect services are available in the browser edition. Explicitly saved designs use local preferences; Wi-Fi passwords are excluded.

imagesplat.name: ImageSplat
imagesplat.description: Edit images with layers, text, shapes, crop, photo adjustments, blur, and local PNG/GIF exports.
help: Import existing images or paste an image when your operating system supports it. Export PNG preserves transparent areas around your artwork.
White and color background removal run locally. AI photo-subject models, live cameras, online background URLs, and the separate FontSplat service are outside this small offline edition.
